newsitem.title: USA: El Paso Energy buys stake in Czech project.
newsitem.headline: El Paso Energy buys stake in Czech project.

text.p: El Paso Energy Corp on Monday said it joined Northern States Power Co in acquiring a stake in a coal- and gas-fired electric generating plant in the Czech Republic in a deal valued at $401 million.

The company said its El Paso Energy International Co unit acquired a 31.15 percent stake in the project. Northern States previously announced its plans to acquire a 57.85 percent interest, with the remaining 11 percent to be owned by local power distributor, Stredoceska Energiticka.
The deal closed Friday with the three power companies contributing $100 million toward the project, El Paso said.
It said the balance of financing was provided by a consortium of banks led by the World Bank's International Finance Corp unit.
The project, located in Kladno, 19 miles west of Prague, is a 250 megawatt coal-fired and 66 megawatt natural gas-fired expansion of an existing 27 megawatt electric generating plant, El Paso said.
